Evidence labels

Tested tested
Tested within the specific experimental scope in the note; not a general proof.
Mechanism mechanism
The mechanism is present or provides indirect support; the research question is not fully isolated.
Unverified unknown
The atlas has not verified evidence for this question; not evidence of absence.
Out of scope outside
Outside the core method's stated scope.

Editorial summaries of cited papers; not independent replications.

DGM

2025

Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents

Select a parent agent from a historical archive, modify its code, and evaluate the resulting variant on coding tasks.

Classification
Archive search & branch evolution
Improvement targets
Agent code, Tools, Context management

Q1 · Can capabilities be inherited? Mechanism

Descendants inherit code, and designs were tested across models. The causal contribution of individual inherited capabilities still requires separate tests.

Evidence source ↗

Q2 · Can lineage improve search? Tested

Archive exploration was compared with linear updates and greedy parent selection. Evidence covers the archive and parent-selection strategies.

Evidence source ↗

Q3 · Do descendants become better improvers? Mechanism

Improved agents continue self-modification, with a fixed initial-improver baseline. General gains in improvement efficiency require further validation.

Evidence source ↗
Original paper ↗Open in atlas ↗

Hyperagents

2026

Hyperagents

Place the task agent and its modifying meta agent in one editable program, allowing the mechanism that generates future improvements to evolve.

Classification
Archive search & branch evolution
Improvement targets
Task agent, Meta agent, Editable improver

Q1 · Can capabilities be inherited? Tested

Meta-level improvements were tested for cross-domain transfer and cross-run reuse. Not every inherited component received a causal ablation.

Evidence source ↗

Q2 · Can lineage improve search? Tested

Open-ended archive exploration baselines were compared. The independent benefit of lineage-depth selection remains to be verified.

Evidence source ↗

Q3 · Do descendants become better improvers? Tested

Section 5.2 freezes a transferred meta agent and measures its ability to generate better agents using imp@50.

Evidence source · Section 5.2 ↗

Study boundary: Some final cross-run differences were not statistically significant. The results do not establish universal or unbounded self-acceleration.

Original paper ↗Open in atlas ↗

ADAS

2024

Automated Design of Agentic Systems

A meta agent programs new agents using an expanding archive of candidates and feeds evaluation results into the next design round.

Classification
Archive search & branch evolution
Improvement targets
Agent code, Prompts, Workflows

Q1 · Can capabilities be inherited? Mechanism

Whole designs were tested across domains and models. This does not isolate the causal effect of component inheritance.

Evidence source ↗

Q2 · Can lineage improve search? Mechanism

The candidate archive informs search. This differs from isolating the value of explicit parent–child lineage.

Evidence source ↗

Q3 · Do descendants become better improvers? Out of scope

The meta-level process in Meta Agent Search remains fixed.

Evidence source ↗
Original paper ↗Open in atlas ↗

Reflexion

2023

Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning

Convert task feedback into verbal reflections stored in episodic memory for later attempts, without updating model weights.

Classification
Experience accumulation
Improvement targets
Episodic memory, Verbal reflection

Q1 · Can capabilities be inherited? Mechanism

Reflective memory was tested for its benefit on later attempts. This does not establish inheritance between independent descendants.

Evidence source ↗

Q2 · Can lineage improve search? Out of scope

The core method does not search a parent–child agent-version lineage.

Evidence source ↗

Q3 · Do descendants become better improvers? Out of scope

A fixed framework executes reflection and update steps.

Evidence source ↗

Voyager

2023

Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models

Improve programs using Minecraft environment feedback and store successful behaviors in a retrievable, composable code-skill library.

Classification
Experience accumulation
Improvement targets
Code skills, Skill library

Q1 · Can capabilities be inherited? Tested

Learned skills were transferred to a new world to solve new tasks. The evidence concerns skill reuse.

Evidence source ↗

Q2 · Can lineage improve search? Out of scope

Skill retrieval and composition do not depend on parent–child version-lineage search.

Evidence source ↗

Q3 · Do descendants become better improvers? Out of scope

The skill-generation and improvement framework remains fixed.

TextGrad

2024

TextGrad: Automatic “Differentiation” via Text

Backpropagate language-model-generated textual feedback through a computation graph to optimize prompts, code, and other system variables.

Classification
Iterative optimization
Improvement targets
Prompts, Code, Textual feedback

Q1 · Can capabilities be inherited? Unverified

Variable optimization gains were demonstrated. Evidence of descendant capability inheritance has not been verified in this atlas.

Evidence source ↗

Q2 · Can lineage improve search? Out of scope

The computation graph describes feedback propagation, not agent-version ancestry.

Evidence source ↗

Q3 · Do descendants become better improvers? Out of scope

The original TextGrad uses a predefined optimization framework.

Evidence source ↗

DSPy

2023

DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines

Express language-model pipelines as declarative modules, then compile them by optimizing demonstrations and other learnable parameters against a target metric.

Classification
Model–harness co-optimization
Improvement targets
Prompt demonstrations, Module parameters, Optional fine-tuning

Q1 · Can capabilities be inherited? Unverified

Compiled pipeline performance was tested. Module reuse and strict capability inheritance require further distinction.

Evidence source ↗

Q2 · Can lineage improve search? Out of scope

Parent–child agent-lineage search is not the original paper's central contribution.

Evidence source ↗

Q3 · Do descendants become better improvers? Out of scope

The compilation process does not target autonomous rewriting of its optimizer.

Evidence source ↗

Self-Refine

2023

Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback

Alternate feedback and revision with the same language model to improve the current task output.

Classification
Related foundations

The study concerns within-task output refinement, not persistent descendant capabilities.

The core process is linear refinement, not agent-version lineage search.

Q3 · Do descendants become better improvers? Out of scope
